name: Omacycle
author: playGitboy
description: Cycle every installed Omarchy theme and wallpaper from the bar or with Super+Ctrl(+Shift)+Left/Right. Choose sequential or random order, cycle the current theme's wallpapers or every theme's, and use a panel that follows the active theme colours.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: pick the icon's bar position, choose sequential or random theme switching, choose current-theme or all-theme wallpaper rotation, enable the Super+Ctrl(+Shift)+Left/Right shortcuts, and see the current theme and wallpaper.

schema.label: Theme switching
schema.description: Sequential walks every installed theme in order; random jumps to a theme that is not the current one.

schema.label: Wallpaper source
schema.description: Use the current theme's wallpapers, or every wallpaper across every installed theme.

schema.label: Random wallpaper
schema.description: Pick a random wallpaper from the chosen source instead of the next one in order.

schema.label: Automatic wallpaper switching
schema.description: When enabled, rotate wallpapers periodically using the selected wallpaper source and random setting.

schema.label: Automatic wallpaper interval (minutes)
schema.description: Minutes between automatic wallpaper changes. The timer is inactive unless automatic switching is enabled.
